# Honest end-to-end run: a real Home Assistant in Docker, House Plan installed
# from the exact release asset HACS ships, two real users, a real browser.
#
# Three suites, each with its own Home Assistant:
#   journeys  — the seeded house: sidebar page, dashboards, roles, phone, PDF, HA restart,
#               every editor and settings dialog, backups (houseplan-card#1010)
#   first-run — the same HA without any plan: the administrator's first contact
#   upgrade   — an older House Plan open in a browser, then the update + restart
#   journeys-dev — the journeys suite against the dev branch snapshot (frontend built from it)
#
# Every scenario leaves evidence frames; each job diffs them against the frames
# of the last stable release (evidence/stable/<tag>, committed by the
# evidence-baseline job after a green stable gate). Material to look at, not a
# gate: the diff never fails a job and never notifies.
name: E2E на реальном Home Assistant

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    # the stable baseline commit of the evidence-baseline job is not a change to test
    paths-ignore: ['evidence/**']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      houseplan_ref:
        description: "House Plan под тестом: latest (беты включительно) | stable | тег | ветка"
        required: false
        default: latest
      upgrade_from:
        description: "Откуда обновляемся: stable (предыдущий, если совпал с целью) | явный тег"
        required: false
        default: stable
      ha_version:
        description: "Тег образа ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant"
        required: false
        default: stable
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"   # ночью: свежая бета House Plan на stable и beta HA

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: e2e-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.event_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # The matrix is planned in a tiny job because a job-level `if` cannot read
  # `matrix.*`: journeys-dev (the dev snapshot) belongs to the nightly only —
  # a red dev must not withhold a stable release dispatched on a tag (#514).
  plan:
    name: Матрица прогона
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.stable_tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      # the unit suite reads PNGs and ZIPs (pngjs, pixelmatch)
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Проверки выбора версий и матрицы
        run: node --test test/*.test.mjs
      - id: plan
        env:
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          HP_REF: ${{ inputs.houseplan_ref || 'latest' }}
          UPGRADE_FROM: ${{ inputs.upgrade_from || 'stable' }}
          HA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.ha_version || 'stable' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/plan-run.mjs
  e2e:
    needs: plan
    # The job name is a contract: houseplan-card's stable release gate (#514)
    # recognises the run it dispatched by ` · HP <tag> · ` in these names.
    name: "${{ matrix.suite }} · HP ${{ matrix.ref }} · HA ${{ matrix.ha }}"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    env:
      HOUSEPLAN_REF: ${{ matrix.target_ref }}
      HOUSEPLAN_EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ matrix.target_version }}
      HA_VERSION: ${{ matrix.ha }}
      HA_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8123
      E2E_RUN_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/run
      E2E_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/evidence-out
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      TG_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TG_BOT_TOKEN }}
      TG_CHAT_ID: ${{ secrets.TG_CHAT_ID }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Зависимости и браузер
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Контракт data-hp — все селекторы объявлены
        run: node scripts/contract.mjs lint

      - name: "Конфиг HA из seed (${{ matrix.variant }})"
        run: node scripts/prepare-seed.mjs --out=run --variant="${{ matrix.variant }}"

      - name: "House Plan ${{ matrix.install_ref }} в конфиг (как ставит HACS)"
        env:
          INSTALL_REF: ${{ matrix.install_ref }}
          INSTALL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.install_version }}
        run: node scripts/install-houseplan.mjs --ref="$INSTALL_REF" --expect-version="$INSTALL_VERSION" --out=run

      - name: Home Assistant в docker
        run: |
          docker pull -q "ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:${HA_VERSION}"
          node scripts/ha.mjs up --version="$HA_VERSION" --dir="$PWD/run"
          node scripts/ha.mjs wait --timeout=480

      - name: Фактическая версия HA и установленный frontend
        run: node scripts/ha-public-version.mjs

      - name: "Сценарии: ${{ matrix.suite }}"
        run: npx playwright test ${{ matrix.projects }}

      - name: Логи HA
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          node scripts/ha.mjs logs > artifacts/docker.log 2>&1 || true
          sudo cp run/home-assistant.log artifacts/home-assistant.log 2>/dev/null || true
          cp run/.e2e-houseplan.json artifacts/ 2>/dev/null || true
          {
            echo "### ${{ matrix.suite }} · HA ${HA_VERSION}"
            echo '```json'; cat run/.e2e-houseplan.json; echo; echo '```'
            echo "Образ: $(docker inspect --format='{{index .Config.Image}}' hp-e2e 2>/dev/null)"
            echo
            echo "Журнал HA (houseplan|custom_components|frontend, error/warning):"
            echo '```'; grep -iE "error|warning" artifacts/home-assistant.log 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "houseplan|custom_comp|frontend" | tail -n 30; echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Кадры-улики и диффы к последнему стабильному (не гейт)
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          mkdir -p evidence-artifact
          cp -r evidence-out evidence-artifact/raw 2>/dev/null || true
          node scripts/evidence-diff.mjs --current=evidence-out --stable=evidence/stable \
            --out=evidence-artifact/diff --title="${{ matrix.suite }} · HA ${{ matrix.ha }}" \
            --artifact="evidence-${{ github.run_number }}-${{ matrix.suite }}-ha-${{ matrix.ha }}" \
            --link="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}#artifacts"

      - name: Артефакты (отчёт, трейсы, скриншоты, логи)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-${{ github.run_number }}-${{ matrix.suite }}-ha-${{ matrix.ha }}
          path: |
            playwright-report
            test-results
            artifacts
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      # frames and diffs live longer than the report: raw/ is what the stable
      # baseline is made of, diff/index.html is the gallery to open
      - name: Артефакт кадров (90 дней)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: evidence-${{ github.run_number }}-${{ matrix.suite }}-ha-${{ matrix.ha }}
          path: evidence-artifact
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Telegram при падении
        if: failure() && env.TG_BOT_TOKEN != '' && env.TG_CHAT_ID != ''
        run: |
          text="❌ E2E House Plan · ${{ matrix.suite }} · HP ${{ matrix.ref }} · HA ${HA_VERSION}: красный. ${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage" \
            --data-urlencode "chat_id=${TG_CHAT_ID}" --data-urlencode "text=${text}"

      - name: Остановить HA
        if: always()
        run: node scripts/ha.mjs down

  # A green stable gate (houseplan-card#1010): its frames become the new "last
  # stable" baseline in this repository. Only when every suite passed, the
  # planner found the stable tag of the dispatched candidate, and the run is of
  # main itself — a run dispatched on an issue branch never writes main.
  evidence-baseline:
    name: Эталон кадров последнего стабильного
    needs: [plan, e2e]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.plan.outputs.stable_tag != '' && needs.e2e.result == 'success'
    # not a gate: houseplan-card's release gate reads the run's conclusion, and
    # a failed baseline commit must not withhold a release
    continue-on-error: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: evidence-${{ github.run_number }}-*-ha-stable
          path: downloaded
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: evidence/stable/${{ needs.plan.outputs.stable_tag }}
        env:
          TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.stable_tag }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          node scripts/evidence-baseline.mjs --tag="$TAG" --from=downloaded/raw
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A evidence/stable
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "baseline unchanged"; exit 0; fi
          git commit -q -m "evidence: stable baseline $TAG" -m "Frames of the green stable gate $RUN_URL (houseplan-card#1010)."
          echo "### Stable baseline: \`evidence/stable/$TAG\` ($(git show --stat --format= HEAD | tail -n 1))" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            git push origin HEAD:main && exit 0
            git pull --rebase -q origin main
          done
          exit 1
